cycle_reporting: TIMERAWL microseconds times125 at checked125MHz; physical cycle equivalents with125-cycle batch quantization, not an independent core cycle counter.
method: Owned code retains its production flash/SRAM placement; Qfplib executes from flash. Identical input order, twelve calibrated rounds with six first runs per library, TIMERAWL, typed soft-float calls and matching calibration leaves. The primary estimator is the median of six opposite-order pair averages. Interrupts enabled. XIP hit/access counters sampled outside timing; include both cores, with paired control counts recorded. Owned math addresses and bytes match production; Qfplib is isolated at 0x10180000. Both libraries warm up inside the APP for at least 1000000 us before timing.
